source.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
source.author: ggcr

title.zh: DeepInfer：面向 DeepSeek 的推理框架

excerpt.zh: DeepInfer 是 DeepSeek 开源的大规模推理框架，支持 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，并提供多种并行、解码和结构化输出功能；完整在线服务仍需另行配置关键组件。
excerpt.en: DeepInfer is DeepSeek’s open-source inference framework for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with parallelism, decoding, and structured-output features. A complete serving stack still requires additional components.

text.zh: DeepInfer 是 DeepSeek 开源的推理框架，项目称其为 DeepSeek 大规模生产服务所使用的框架，并开放了用于离线推理的核心能力。当前列出的支持模型是 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。
text.en: DeepInfer is an open-source inference framework that DeepSeek says powers its large-scale production services. The release exposes core capabilities for offline inference, and currently lists DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as its supported model.

text.zh: 框架包含优化内核，以及注意力和专家混合等并行机制；它还提供异步调度、草稿令牌辅助解码、确定性采样和受约束的结构化输出。硬件支持列为 NVIDIA SM100 GPU 与华为昇腾 950 NPU。上述功能和平台支持都有明确边界，不能据此推断其他模型或硬件也能直接运行。
text.en: The framework includes optimized kernels and parallelism for attention and mixture-of-experts workloads, alongside asynchronous scheduling, draft-token-assisted decoding, deterministic sampling, and constrained structured outputs. Listed hardware includes NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs. These stated features and platforms define the available scope; they do not establish compatibility with other models or accelerators.

text.zh: DeepInfer 尚非完整在线服务
text.en: DeepInfer is not a complete serving stack

text.zh: 最重要的限制是，发布版本没有包含完整推理服务所需的全部组件：KV 缓存系统、预填充与解码的分离部署，以及跨数据并行副本的负载均衡仍需补齐。因此，团队评估时应区分框架已实现的推理功能与自行搭建服务所需的工程工作。
text.en: The key limitation is that this release omits components needed for a complete inference service: a KV-cache system, prefill/decode disaggregation, and load balancing across data-parallel replicas. Teams evaluating it should distinguish the inference features already implemented from the additional engineering needed to build an operational serving stack.

text.zh: 项目以 Apache 2.0 许可发布。实际部署还受环境要求约束，包括 Linux、GCC 13 或更高版本及 Python 3.12；NVIDIA 路径需要 CUDA 13，昇腾路径需要 CANN 9.2。现有材料没有提供足以概括的性能数字，性能判断应参考项目的可复现实测流程，并结合目标硬件与负载验证。
text.en: The project is released under the Apache 2.0 license. Deployment also depends on specific prerequisites: Linux, GCC 13 or later, and Python 3.12; the NVIDIA path requires CUDA 13, while the Ascend path requires CANN 9.2. The supplied material does not establish a general performance figure, so teams should consult the project’s reproducible benchmark procedure and test against their own hardware and workloads.
